translation.src_text: MIT a sitiye nan Cambridge, Massachusetts, across the Charles River from downtown Boston. Se sèlman yo gen obligasyon elèv yo elèv premye ane yo viv sou lakou lekòl la, men sou 70 pousan elèv chwazi yo rete sou lakou lekòl la pandan kat ane yo. MIT ofri lojman nan youn nan dortwar yo koul nan peyi a, souvan yo rele "Eponj nan," ki fèt nan achitèk Steven Holl. Enjenyè yo MIT fè grandizè plis pase 30 ekip NCAA Divizyon III, ak maskot yo se yon kastò, ki MIT te chwazi paske yo te li yo "jeni remakab ak konpetans mekanik ak abitid li yo nan endistri." Chak klas desen yon bag inik rele "an kwiv rat" ki se devwale pandan ane sophomore, yon tradisyon ki dat tounen nan 1929.
translation.tgt_text: MIT is located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, across the Charles River from downtown Boston. Only freshmen are required to live on campus, but about 70 percent of students choose to live on campus for all four years. MIT offers housing in one of the coolest dormitories in the country, often called "The Sponge," designed by architect Steven Holl. MIT engineers field more than 30 NCAA Division III teams, and their mascot is a beaver, which MIT chose because of its "remarkable engineering and mechanical skills and its habits of industry." Each class wears a unique ring called the "brass rat" that is unveiled during sophomore year, a tradition that dates back to 1929.

translation.src_text: Lè wa Akaz te lavil Damas pou l te kontre ak Tiglat-Pilesè , wa peyi Lasiri a , li wè lotèl ki te la a . Li leve plan lotèl la , li voye l bay Ouri , prèt la .

translation.src_text: Moun ki vin rich nan prete moun lajan , nan bay kout ponya , se anpile y'ap anpile lajan pou moun ki konn pran ka malere .

translation.src_text: Sa ban nou yon lòt rezon ankò pou nou mete konfyans nou nan Jewova, e se yon garanti ki montre espwa nou pa pou granmesi. — Travay 17: 31; Women 5: 5; 1 Korentyen 15: 3 - 8.
translation.tgt_text: This gives us further reason to trust in Jehovah, and it is a guarantee that our hope is not in vain. —Acts 17:31; Romans 5:5; 1 Corinthians 15:3-8.

translation.src_text: Pa kite pèsonn pou plante jaden ! Pa kite pèsonn pou ranmase lè sezon rekòt rive ! Lè lagè a va pete , tout moun lòt nasyon yo va chache chemen pa yo , y'a kouri met deyò al lakay yo .
translation.tgt_text: Let no one plant the field , let no one gather the harvest , and when the war breaks out , all the nations will flee to their own homes .

translation.src_text: Bezaleyèl fè lòtèl pou boule ofrann yo an bwa zakasya . Li fè l' kare kare : Li te mezire sèt pye sis pous longè , sèt pye sis pous lajè , kat pye sis pous wotè .
translation.tgt_text: Bezalel made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. He made it square: its length was seven feet six inches, its width seven feet six inches, and its height four feet six inches.

translation.src_text: Annefè, Pyè deklare: "Jou Jewova a ap vini tankou yon vòlè". — 2 Pyè 3: 10.
translation.tgt_text: Indeed, Peter declared: “Jehovah’s day will come as a thief.”​—2 Peter 3:10.

translation.src_text: ( 29 ) Se Senyè a ki wa . Se li ki donminen sou tout nasyon .
translation.tgt_text: ( 29 ) The Lord reigns , and he rules over all the nations .

translation.src_text: Men , mwen pral pase yon lòd . Mwen pral vannen moun Izrayèl ki nan mitan lòt nasyon yo tankou yo vannen grenn nan laye . Pa menm yon bon grenn p'ap tonbe atè .
translation.tgt_text: But I will give the command , and I will sift the house of Israel among the nations , as one sifts grain in a sieve , and not a single good grain will fall to the ground .

translation.src_text: Nou menm k'ap fè sèvis sou mòn yo , nan mitan pyebwa yo , m'ap fè moun vin piye richès nou yo ak trezò nou yo poutèt peche nou te fè sou mòn yo toupatou nan peyi a .

translation.src_text: Se ak li Bondye te kreye tou sa ki nan syèl la ak sou latè , sa nou wè ak sa nou pa wè . Se ak li li kreye tout lespri yo ki chita ap donminen , ki gen otorite , ki chèf epi ki gen pouvwa . Se ak Kris la Bondye te kreye yo tout , epi se pou li li te kreye yo .
translation.tgt_text: For by him all things were created, that are in heaven and that are in earth, visible and invisible, and by him all principalities and powers and rulers and authorities. For in him all things were created, and for him all things were created.

translation.src_text: E Satan, prensipal ènmi w lan, ap sèvi ak yon zam ki se yon gwo danje pou ou.

translation.src_text: Kenbe pawòl Kris la ak tout richès li yo byen fèm nan kè nou . Se pou nou yonn aprann nan men lòt , se pou nou yonn bay lòt konsèy avèk anpil bon konprann . Se pou nou chante sòm , kantik ak tout lòt chante Lespri Bondye a va moutre nou , pou di Bondye mèsi ak tout kè nou .

translation.tgt_text: There are also others who are in love with people who are not Jehovah's Witnesses.

translation.tgt_text: Use the appendix in the New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures if it is available in a language you know.

translation.src_text: Men sa Pòl te di ansyen nan kongregasyon Efèz yo: Fè atansyon ak tèt nou e ak tout twoupo lespri sen etabli nou siveyan sou li a, pou nou pran swen kongregasyon Bondye a, kongregasyon li achte ak san pwòp Pitit li a.
translation.tgt_text: Paul told the elders of the Ephesian congregation: “Pay attention to yourselves and to all the flock, among which the holy spirit has appointed you overseers, to shepherd the congregation of God, which he purchased with the blood of his own Son.”

translation.src_text: Sepandan, olye pou n ap fache pou nenpòt ti krik ti krak, sa ki kapab fè n kraze lapè ki gen nan kongregasyon an, ann eseye imite Jewova epi annou padone youn lòt ak tout kè nou toutpandan n ap kontinye travay kòtakòt nan sèvis Jewova a.
translation.tgt_text: However, rather than becoming angry over minor disagreements, which could disrupt the peace of the congregation, let us strive to imitate Jehovah and forgive one another from the heart as we continue to work side by side in Jehovah’s service.

translation.tgt_text: This knowledge has helped many to become morally clean, to break free from bad habits, to improve their relationships with their families, and to have a better relationship with God, the Author of the Bible.

translation.src_text: Lefètke Jewova pa t deside montre menm kote a se li menm ki Souvren an, li te bay Satan tan pou l pwouve sa l te di yo.

translation.src_text: Men sa l ajoute: "Men, avèk jantiyès, mari m te ede m konprann nou pa responsab pitit nou an ankò e n pa dwe antre nan zafè l."

translation.src_text: Nan Paradi Jewova pral tabli sou tè a nan yon tikras tan ankò, pap manke okazyon pou nou pwofite jenewozite Jewova totalman, ansanm ak konpayi agreyab tout moun ki respekte egzijans li yo ki jis. — Sòm 145: 16; Izayi 25: 6; 2 Korentyen 7: 1.
translation.tgt_text: In the Paradise that Jehovah will soon establish on earth, there will be no shortage of opportunities to benefit fully from Jehovah’s generosity, including the pleasant company of all who meet his righteous requirements. —Psalm 145:16; Isaiah 25:6; 2 Corinthians 7:1.

translation.src_text: Se konsa Pilat pran desizyon pou l' ba yo sa yo te mande a .

translation.src_text: Men sa li di: "Menm jan mwen vivan, [...] mwen pran plezi, non pa nan lanmò mechan an, men pou moun ki mechan an vire kite chemen l e vrèman pou li rete vivan." .
translation.tgt_text: He says: “As long as I live, […] I take delight, not in the death of the wicked, but in that the wicked turn from his way and keep living.” .

translation.src_text: Se pou rezon sa a, Jezi Kris te di yo avèk franchiz: Gade!

translation.tgt_text: However, if you give the brother you entrust with responsibility a little freedom, he may gain confidence and experience.

translation.src_text: Nou tout ap goumen ak pwòp enpèfeksyon pa nou ansanm ak enpèfeksyon lòt moun.

translation.src_text: Li fè lanèj tonbe kouvri latè tankou koton . Li fè lawouze tounen ti mòso glas sou tout pyebwa .
translation.tgt_text: He makes the snow fall like cotton and covers the earth like a blanket. He turns the dew into icicles on all the trees.

translation.src_text: Byenke alyans ak Abraram nan te reyalize yon fason literal pou desandan Abraram yo lè yo te antre nan Latè pwomiz, Ekriti yo montre alyans sa a t ap gen yon akonplisman espirityèl tou.
translation.tgt_text: Although the Abrahamic covenant was fulfilled in a literal way for Abraham's descendants when they entered the Promised Land, the Scriptures show that this covenant would also have a spiritual fulfillment.

translation.src_text: Premye kretyen sa yo te kontinye pwogrese nan domèn espirityèl paske Bondye te beni yo. — Pwo.
